claims.claim_text: Mercury asserts forward revenue concentration on F-35, Filthy Buzzard & Badger, F/A-18, LTAMDS, THAAD and Aegis as a 'large portion of our future revenues in the coming years'.
claims.subject: Mercury Systems
claims.object_value: F-35, Filthy Buzzard & Badger, F/A-18, LTAMDS, THAAD, Aegis
claims.source_quote: Going forward, we believe F-35, Filthy Buzzard & Badger, F/A-18, LTAMDS, THAAD and Aegis programs could be a large portion of our future revenues in the coming years, and the loss or cancellation of these programs could adversely affect our future results.

claims.claim_text: Mercury says products are deployed on a portfolio of specific defense programs of record including Aegis, Patriot, LTAMDS, SEWIP, THAAD, Predator, F-35, Reaper, F-18, F-16 SABR, E2-D Hawkeye, Paveway, Filthy Buzzard, PGK, P-8, AIDEWS, CDS, AMCS and WIN-T.
claims.subject: Mercury Systems
claims.object_value: Aegis, Patriot, LTAMDS, SEWIP, THAAD, Predator, F-35, Reaper, F-18, F-16 SABR, E2-D Hawkeye, Paveway, Filthy Buzzard, PGK, P-8, AIDEWS, CDS, AMCS, WIN-T
claims.source_quote: we have successfully penetrated strategic programs including Aegis, Patriot, Lower Tier Air & Missile Defense Sensor ("LTAMDS"), Surface Electronic Warfare Improvement Program (SEWIP), Terminal High Altitude Area Defense ("THAAD"), Predator, F-35, Reaper, F-18, F-16 SABR, E2-D Hawkeye, Paveway, Filthy Buzzard, PGK, P-8, Advanced Integrated Defensive Electronic Warfare Suite (AIDEWS), Common Display System (CDS), Aviation Mission Common Server ("AMCS") and WIN-T.

claims.claim_text: Mercury reports customer-concentration: in fiscal 2022 Raytheon Technologies = 14%, U.S. Navy = 14%, Lockheed Martin = 10% of total net revenues; defense + U.S. government sales = ~97% of FY2022 revenues.
claims.subject: Mercury Systems
claims.object_value: RTX=14%, U.S. Navy=14%, LMT=10%, defense/USG total ~97%
claims.source_quote: In fiscal 2022, Raytheon Technologies accounted for 14% of our total net revenues, the U.S. Navy accounted for 14% of our total net revenues and Lockheed Martin Corporation accounted for 10% of our total net revenues.

claims.claim_text: Mercury says products are deployed on more than 300 programs with over 25 different defense prime contractors and commercial aviation customers.
claims.subject: Mercury Systems
claims.source_quote: Our products and solutions are deployed in more than 300 programs with over 25 different defense prime contractors and commercial aviation customers.

claims.claim_text: Mercury asserts it is positioned to capitalize on DoD program-protection / embedded-security mandates with its next-gen secure Intel server-class product line ('our security solutions ... position us well to capitalize on DoD program protection security requirements').
claims.subject: Mercury Systems
claims.source_quote: Our security solutions, combined with our next-generation secure Intel server-class product line, together with increasingly frequent mandates from the government to secure electronic systems for domestic and foreign military sales, position us well to capitalize on DoD program protection security requirements.

claims.claim_text: Mercury attests ongoing investment in radar modernization, avionics mission computers, secure processing, and trusted custom microelectronics as future growth vectors.
claims.subject: Mercury Systems
claims.object_value: radar modernization, avionics mission computing, secure processing, trusted microelectronics
claims.source_quote: internal R&D to promote future growth, including new opportunities in avionics mission computers, secure processing, radar modernization and trusted custom microelectronics.

claims.claim_text: Mercury anticipates FMS (foreign military sales) becoming an increasing part of revenue going forward.
claims.subject: Mercury Systems
claims.object_value: FMS sales increasing share of revenues
claims.source_quote: We anticipate that sales to our U.S. prime defense contractor customers as part of foreign military sales (FMS) programs will be an increasing part of our business going forward.

claims.object_value: FY22 rev $988.2M; $117.8M acquired; 15 deals/$1.4B since FY14
